## 🐞 Bug Reporting Policy

To streamline issue tracking and ensure smooth debugging, we ask all contributors and users to report bugs **specifically against the `bug` branch**.

### 🚨 Why?
This allows us to keep development separate from issue resolution and provide dedicated focus on bug-related fixes.

### ✅ Steps to Report a Bug

1. Pull the latest `bug` branch
2. Reproduce the issue (if possible)
3. Submit your bug report using the **Bug Report** template
4. Fill out all required sections for clarity

📍 Link to `bug` branch: https://github.com/Gaturu/ledgers/tree/bug

Your participation helps keep **Ledgers** clean, accurate, and reliable for all!
